subcategory_text: Data are transmitted using standardized formats.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SC-16 (Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes)
implementation_examples: Transmit data using standardised, documented formats (e.g., JSON, XML, CSV) and machine-readable interfaces (e.g., web APIs) so that consumers can ingest the data reliably
Document the format standards in a published schema catalogue
Ensure portability for individual rights requests under GDPR Art. 20
assessment_objectives: Determine whether standard data formats are used for transmissions
Determine whether the standard formats are documented and versioned
Determine whether consumers can ingest the formats reliably
Determine whether portability under individual rights requests is supported
